name: Khwaja Abdul Hadi Khan
contribution: Khwaja Abdul Hadi Khan served as faujdar of Rajmahal and is identified in Bengal historical accounts as a regional authority connected with the Plassey-era power contest.
context: Regional military-administrative authority in Nawabi Bengal.
impact: His inclusion reflects how district-level military administrators were tied to the wider crisis of 1757 and the reordering of authority in Bengal.
highlight: Faujdar of Rajmahal connected to the political contest around Plassey.
seoTitle: Khwaja Abdul Hadi Khan: Faujdar of Rajmahal
seoDescription: Learn about Khwaja Abdul Hadi Khan and the Rajmahal military-administrative authority he held during the Plassey era.
shortAnswer: Khwaja Abdul Hadi Khan was the faujdar of Rajmahal during the political crisis surrounding Plassey.
